name: Honest gap outranks a manufactured green
section: Finishing rungs — what stands between "stopped talking" and "delivered"
prose: every finishing text names "I could not run this here, and here is what stays unverified" as a COMPLETE answer, and points at confirming the contract (signature, docstring, return type) where the behaviour is unreachable. Load-bearing, not politeness: a rung that demanded a passing check would make standing the dependency in the cheapest way to satisfy it, manufacturing the exact failure the floor exists to catch.
invariant: Naming what could not be run and what stays unverified is a FULLY correct ending — the rung must never manufacture a green.
